description: Least privilege: the SPA needs only the core window APIs, plus the auto-backup's narrow slice (fs strictly under $DOCUMENT/MEW, opener for that folder) and the calendar-connect slice (loopback start/cancel, opener for Google's auth origin only). The gbrain sidecar is deliberately absent: Rust spawns, restarts, and kills it — granting the webview shell:allow-execute (even sidecar-scoped) would hand it arbitrary-argument spawn rights it never needs; it only receives {url, token} via the brain_endpoint handshake.
